blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Banga National High School (BNHS) is gradually bringing students back to face-to-face classes under tighter security measures following the Sept. 18 shooting. The school has also banned smartphones on campus to encourage students to interact more with their classmates. The campus shooting left three students dead, including the shooter, and six others injured. Mildred Bagaman, BNHS academic chairperson, said the staggered return to in-person classes, which began Monday, Oct. 19, was decided after consultations with the Parent-Teacher Association, local government unit, police, and other stakeholders.
